queries: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) * 1.0 / SUM(derived_total_cost) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS overall_avg FROM inv) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.avg_qty AS average_quantity, i.cost_ratio, i.avg_qty - o.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall FROM inv i CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE i.avg_qty > o.overall_avg ORDER BY diff_above_overall DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity is stored as text but holds numeric values, so it is cast to REAL for averaging.
The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-invoice average quantities, as the request states, not the mean over all lines.
If an invoice's total derived_total_cost is 0, the ratio is NULL (division by zero) and the invoice is still listed.

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity is stored as text but holds numeric values, so it is cast to a number before averaging.
The overall average is the mean of the per-invoice average quantities, so each invoice counts once. It is not the mean over all lines. Invoices whose average is NULL are left out of it.
If an invoice's total derived_total_cost is 0 or NULL, its cost ratio is NULL. The invoice can still appear if its average quantity qualifies.
